name: local-artifact-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin: artifact-style commenting for any locally-opened page.

scripts.reinstall: claude plugin uninstall local-artifact@local-artifact >/dev/null 2>&1; claude plugin install local-artifact@local-artifact
scripts.check: for f in lib/*.mjs bridge/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs extension/*.js test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo "all files parse"
